name: Dust of Misdirection
summary: A pinch of grey dust that makes pursuers lose your trail.
description: Sold in twists of paper by traveling peddlers who can't say where they get it. It glitters when it falls.

stats.effect: As a Bonus Action, you can scatter this dust around you. For 1 hour, creatures tracking you by sight, scent, or magic have Disadvantage on checks to follow your trail, and the dust is consumed.
